modules.title: Module 1: Core primitives access control and cryptography

topics.title: Access Control Models: Mandatory Access Control (MAC), Discretionary Access Control (DAC), and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Identity Management: Authentication protocols, Multi-factor authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO)

modules.title: Module 2: System security network attacks and malware analysis

topics.title: Communication Safety: Secure Email protocols (PGP, S/MIME) and transport layer security layers (TLS/SSL)

Network Vulnerabilities: DoS, DDoS structures, IP Spoofing, and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks
Perimeter Defenses: Firewall architectures (Packet filtering, Stateful inspection, Application proxy), IDS/IPS

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction to compiling lexical analysis

topics.title: Analysis-synthesis model of compilation, Phases of a compiler, Grouping of phases, Compiler construction tools, Bootstrapping
Input Buffering strategies, Specification of tokens using Regular Expressions, Review of Finite Automata
Lexical Analysis: role of Lexical Analyzer, Issues, Tokens, Lexemes, and Patterns
Recognition of Tokens: Transition diagrams, Lexical Analyzer Generator tools (LEX/FLEX)
Bottom-Up Parsing: Shift-Reduce parsing model, Handle pruning, Operator Precedence parsing, Viable prefixes
Deterministic Top-Down: Eliminating Left Recursion, Left Factoring, Construction of $LL(1)$ parsing tables

modules.title: Module 3: Syntax directed translation runtime environments

topics.title: Intermediate Code Generation: Syntax trees, DAG, Postfix notation, and Three-Address Code (Quadruples, Triples, Indirect Triples)
Runtime Environments: Storage organization, Activation records, Stack allocation, Access to non-local data, Heap management
Syntax-Directed Translation (SDT): SDD, Inherited and Synthesized attributes, Evaluation orders, S-attributed, L-attributed definitions
Translation Schemes: Translation of expressions, type declarations, control-flow assignments, and boolean expressions

modules.title: Module 4: Code optimization target code generation

topics.title: Code Optimization: Principal sources of optimization, Optimization of basic blocks, Data-flow analysis foundations, Loop optimization
Resource Optimization: Next-use information tracking, simple code generator, Register allocation and assignment, DAG representation
Target Code Generation: Issues in design, target machine description, Basic blocks and Flow graphs

modules.title: Module 1: Instruction level parallelism ilp and dynamic execution

topics.title: Branch Prediction: Dynamic branch prediction architectures, Branch Prediction Buffers (BPB), Correlating predictors, BTB
Dynamic Scheduling: Tomasulo’s Algorithm (architecture, reservation stations, execution stages)
Hazards & Speculation: Control dependencies, Control hazards, Techniques for reducing branch penalties
ILP Foundations: Concepts and challenges, Data dependencies, and Name dependencies (True, Anti, and Output dependencies)

modules.title: Module 2: Hardware speculation and multiple issue processors

topics.title: Compiler-Driven ILP: Compiler techniques for exposing parallelism, Loop Unrolling, Static Branch Prediction, Software Pipelining
Hardware-Based Speculation: Concepts, Reorder Buffers (ROB), integration of Tomasulo's algorithm with hardware speculation
Multiple-Issue Processors: Architectures of Superscalar processors and Very Long Instruction Word (VLIW) configurations

modules.title: Module 3: Thread level parallelism and cache coherence

topics.title: Cache Coherence Problem: Core reasons for data inconsistency across independent caching nodes
Coherence Protocols: Snooping-based Protocols (MSI and MESI state machines), and Directory-based cache coherence frameworks
Multiprocessor Taxonomy: Centralized Shared-Memory architectures and Distributed Shared-Memory setups
Synchronization & Consistency: Hardware primitives for atomic memory operations, Memory Consistency models
